title: Jude and the Postcards
author: Felix Hartwell
blurb: Theo Galloway, a restaurant critic who has forgotten how food tastes, has spent three years practicing the art of almost saying it. Then a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the stranger in the old photographs before the demolition date arrives.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
